message.reasoning:
I need to decide whether to bid on the auction for the property.

I have $889 and a dark blue monopoly. I'm bidding on Marvin Gardens against p1 at $80. The yellow set is incomplete. Ventnor is owned by a cash-poor player.

p1 has $320 cash but is in jail and owns an orange monopoly with houses. The mortgage value of Marvin Gardens is $140, so bidding under that threshold would be free money. I will bid to complete the yellow set and pressure p4 into bankruptcy.

I am calculating rent costs to judge the bid. New York Avenue with three houses pays $650. Virginia Avenue with three houses pays $500. p2 has eight houses on the pink set. I need enough cash to cover these hits.

States Avenue with three houses pays $450. St Charles Place has two houses.

I will bid $81 to match the current high. After purchase I have $808, which survives a $650 rent hit with a $158 cushion. I will continue bidding in $1 increments until I reach roughly $160–$170.

Draining p1's cash is strategic because they are in jail and own an orange set. I will bid $81 and keep the message short.
